title: Prospect Audit Teaser
description: Run a quick audit of a prospect's social presence, score it, and produce a pitch-ready PDF teaser that opens the sales conversation with specific, credible findings.

inputs.label: Prospect's main social profile URL (Instagram preferred)

nodes.title: Quick-audit the prospect's presence
nodes.detail: Open the prospect's profile and record the fundamentals: followers, bio quality, link-in-bio, highlights, posting frequency over the last month, and the 10 most recent posts (format, hook, likes, comments, date). Also run one web search for the brand to note other active channels and anything notable (reviews, press).
nodes.acceptance: Profile fundamentals, 10 recent posts, and other-channel notes captured.

subtasks.title: Collect 10 recent posts
subtasks.purpose: Format, hook, and engagement per post

subtasks.title: Scan other channels
subtasks.purpose: One search pass for presence beyond this profile

inputScope.name: prospect_name
inputScope.description: Search term for the channel scan

outputScope.name: recent_posts
outputScope.description: 10 posts: format, hook, likes, comments, date

nodes.title: Score the account and pick 3 opportunities
nodes.detail: Score the account 1–10 on five dimensions: profile optimization, content consistency, format mix, hook quality, and engagement rate. For each dimension write a one-line justification grounded in the collected data. Then pick the 3 highest-impact opportunities — specific, credible fixes the prospect will recognize as true, phrased as outcomes ('Reels with question hooks are your top performers — you posted only 2 last month').
nodes.acceptance: Five scores with justifications and three specific opportunities.

subtasks.title: Select three opportunities
subtasks.purpose: Specific findings that open a sales conversation

nodes.title: Verify audit credibility
nodes.detail: Check that all five scores have data-grounded justifications (no generic claims), each opportunity cites something actually observed in the collected posts or profile, and no claim contradicts the collected data.

nodes.title: Write the pitch-ready PDF teaser
nodes.detail: Write a 2–3 page PDF teaser: (1) cover section — prospect name, date, prepared-by agency line, (2) scorecard — the five scores in a table with one-line evidence each, (3) top 3 opportunities — each with the finding, why it matters, and what better looks like, (4) a soft close — one paragraph inviting a 20-minute walkthrough, no hard sell. Professional, specific, and short enough to read in three minutes.
nodes.acceptance: PDF saved with cover, scorecard, three opportunities, and soft close.

subtasks.title: Build the scorecard section
subtasks.purpose: Five scores with evidence in a scannable table

subtasks.title: Write the opportunity pages
subtasks.purpose: Finding → impact → what better looks like

subtasks.title: Close with the soft CTA
subtasks.purpose: Invite the call without selling hard
